name: NX4 KOR: Tucson NX4 (Korea)
description: HMG-API mod for the Korean Tucson NX4 (260902), no NEMESIS needed. Now: wireless CarPlay and Android Auto from Korea Projection (StopDragon) - hmgapid runs its hotspot service (svc/hotspot.sh) as root, installs its status app, and starts the status script when the app opens.
